description: Compares two V8 .cpuprofile files (before and after an optimization) and returns per-function CPU time deltas, normalized against each profile's total duration. Frames are matched by call-frame coordinates (functionName + url + line + column), not by transient node IDs, so alignment is stable across profiling sessions. Use to answer: which functions improved or regressed after my change, and by how much?

after_profile_path.description: Absolute path to the optimized .cpuprofile file to compare against the baseline

before_profile_path.description: Absolute path to the baseline .cpuprofile file

top_n.description: Number of top improvements and regressions to return (default: 5)

name: diff_profiles
